notes: The sensor is on lab port uart4. The backend talks to the STM32 console and relays sensor commands with 'send uart4 ...'.
uart4 boots at 115200 while the sensor transmits at 9600, so until the baud is fixed uart4 only sees a 0x00 flood (zeros and FE climb).
The first sensor command after any reconfiguration may get 'ERR unknown cmd' from stale bytes in the sensor's line buffer. The backend retries once (retried_after).
A cfg the board rejects is reported with ok=false and the console reply. If it was a port-level failure, the backend restores the last good config (restored_config).

Failure signatures: notices with '0x00 suppressed' = gross baud mismatch or RX held low; no data at all = loose wire or sensor not transmitting; garbled lines + FE = wrong baud or framing; PE = parity mismatch.

Sampling results include link counter deltas for the port (rx, ORE, FE, NE, PE, zeros, dropped), seq_gaps (missed frames) and garbled_lines. Error counters count polls, not bytes: read them as zero vs climbing.

ports.description: List every lab port: open/closed, configured and actual baud, framing and link counters.

set_baud.description: Set the baud rate of the lab port the sensor is on.

set_data_bits.description: Set the number of data bits (excluding parity) of the lab port.

set_parity.description: Set the parity of the lab port.

set_stop_bits.description: Set the number of stop bits of the lab port.

clear_counters.description: Zero the lab port's RX/TX and error counters.

sensor_ping.description: Link check: send PING to the sensor and wait for PONG.

sensor_id.description: Ask the sensor for its identity string.

sensor_read.description: Request one reading from the sensor.

set_rate.description: Set the sensor's stream period in milliseconds (minimum 100).

rate_ms.description: Stream period in ms, at least 100

sensor_echo.description: Loopback integrity check: the sensor sends the text back.

stream_on.description: Start the sensor's periodic stream of readings.

stream_off.description: Stop the sensor's periodic stream of readings.
